seo.metaTitle: Agency Partnership | Amazon Collaboration for Agencies | eCom Gliders
seo.metaDescription: Apply to partner with eCom Gliders. White-label, referral, and co-managed Amazon delivery for complementary agencies—not an open vendor pitch inbox.

hero.title: Amazon delivery capacity for agencies that already own the relationship
hero.subtitle: eCom Gliders collaborates with complementary agencies that need a trusted Amazon bench—white-label execution, referrals, or co-managed lanes—without turning this page into an open RFP for unrelated vendors.
hero.forLine: For: digital, creative, web, PR, 3PL, finance, and other agencies whose clients ask for Amazon work you do not staff in-house.
hero.notForLine: Not for: Amazon brands seeking services (use Free Audit), freelancers pitching us work, or vendors selling tools, media, or sponsorships to eCom Gliders.

demand.heading: Amazon shows up in client conversations before you have a full Amazon team
demand.intro: Many agencies win brands on web, creative, logistics, or finance—then Amazon demand appears. Building a full Amazon ops bench is expensive. Leaving the ask unanswered risks the relationship.

signals.title: Clients ask for Amazon, not another agency pitch deck
signals.description: They want listings, ads, and catalog health handled without starting a second agency search from scratch.

signals.title: Hiring a full Amazon pod is a multi-role commitment
signals.description: PPC, listings, creative, catalog, and account ops rarely fit one generalist hire—and overflow still happens.

signals.title: You need capacity without losing the client relationship
signals.description: Partners want delivery they can stand behind, with clear rules so eCom Gliders does not compete for the account.

lanes.heading: Three ways to collaborate—pick the model that matches how you sell
lanes.intro: Commercial terms are set after a fit review. On this page we define operating models, not published commission rates.

items.title: White-label delivery
items.summary: We execute agreed Amazon work under your brand. You remain the face of the relationship.
items.bestWhen: Best when you already sell Amazon as part of your offer and need a reliable backend team.
items.brandOnWork: Deliverables and day-to-day client contact stay under your brand unless you ask otherwise.

items.title: Referral
items.summary: You introduce Amazon-ready brands. We engage under the eCom Gliders brand with clear handoff rules.
items.bestWhen: Best when Amazon is adjacent to your practice and you prefer not to productize Amazon delivery yourself.
items.brandOnWork: eCom Gliders leads Amazon delivery and reporting with the referred brand.

items.title: Co-manage
items.summary: You keep strategy and relationship ownership. We run defined Amazon lanes such as PPC, listings, or catalog.
items.bestWhen: Best when you have an Amazon-aware lead but need specialized execution capacity.
items.brandOnWork: Roles, tools access, and reporting cadence are written into the kickoff scope.

complement.heading: Your practice stays yours. Amazon lanes stay clear.
complement.intro: We partner to extend Amazon capacity—not to absorb your core service line or open an inbox for every vendor pitch.

yourPractice.heading: Your practice stays yours
items: Brand, creative, and content studios outside Amazon modules
General management consulting unrelated to Amazon execution

weDoNot.heading: We do not
items: Run an open vendor pitch or sponsorship marketplace on this page
Invite freelancers to sell unrelated services into eCom Gliders
Compete for your retained clients’ non-Amazon scopes that you already deliver
Promise exclusive territory or published partner rates before a fit review

protection.heading: Rules that keep your relationship intact
protection.intro: Agency partners need operational clarity before sharing a client. These are the defaults we start from; details are confirmed in writing before kickoff.

items.title: NDA-ready collaboration
items.description: We work under confidentiality expectations appropriate to shared client work and can execute a mutual NDA when required.

items.title: Non-solicit posture
items.description: We do not use partner introductions to solicit your non-Amazon retained scopes or to poach your agency clients.

items.title: Communication control
items.description: For white-label and co-manage work, we do not contact your client independently unless you request or approve it.

items.title: Brand on deliverables
items.description: White-label work ships under your brand conventions. Referral work is clearly eCom Gliders-branded with a clean handoff.

cadence.heading: From application to operating rhythm
cadence.intro: Partnership starts with fit—not a calendar link for every inbound message.

steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Submit the partner application with your agency site, services, lane preference, and Amazon demand you do not staff.

steps.title: Fit review
steps.description: We review complementarity and capacity. Expect a reply within about two business days.

steps.title: Define lane and scope
steps.description: We align on white-label, referral, or co-manage, plus access, reporting, and brand rules.

steps.title: Kickoff
steps.description: Accounts, tools, and communication paths are set before execution begins.

steps.title: Reporting rhythm
steps.description: You receive an agreed cadence so your client relationship stays informed without surprises.

fit.heading: Who we approve—and who we decline
fit.intro: We keep a selective partner cohort so delivery quality stays high. Quality over volume.

approve.heading: We typically approve
items: Active agencies with a public website and a clear service offer
Teams whose core work complements Amazon rather than duplicating our entire stack
Partners with real client Amazon demand they cannot staff today
Operators willing to define lane, access, and communication rules in writing

decline.heading: We typically decline
items: Individuals or vendors pitching tools, media, or services to eCom Gliders
Lead brokers with no agency delivery relationship
Applications without a website or without a complementary practice
Requests that treat this page like a general contact form for seller audits

items.question: Will eCom Gliders contact or solicit my clients?
items.answer: For white-label and co-manage engagements, we follow your communication rules and do not independently solicit your clients for non-Amazon work you already provide. Referral introductions are engaged under the eCom Gliders brand with a clear handoff.

items.question: Do you offer exclusivity by region or niche?
items.answer: Exclusivity is not automatic. If exclusivity matters to your model, raise it during fit review so we can evaluate capacity and conflict risk honestly.

items.question: How do we disclose the partnership to clients?
items.answer: White-label work can stay under your brand. Referral and co-manage disclosures are agreed at kickoff so the client understands who executes Amazon work.

items.question: Is there a minimum volume?
items.answer: There is no public minimum on this page. We prioritize fit and delivery quality. Volume expectations are discussed after approval.

items.question: How fast do you reply to applications?
items.answer: We aim to respond within about two business days. Incomplete applications may take longer or be declined.

close.heading: Selective by design
close.body: If you run a complementary agency and need Amazon capacity under clear rules, apply above. For unrelated vendor pitches or brand service requests, use Contact or Free Audit instead.
